statement.title: Stationary gates $\mathrm{CS}_{yz}^a\CCZ^b$ and complete affine flags
statement.full_tex: The gates $G=\mathrm{CS}_{yz}^a\CCZ^b$ with $a,b\in\F_2$, that is, $I$, $\mathrm{CS}_{yz}$, $\CCZ$ and $\mathrm{CS}_{yz}\CCZ$, are stationary, with $135$, $3$, $15$ and $3$ GSC pairs. Let $\pi$ be the permutation of $CGC^\dagger$, where $C\in\C_2(3)$ maps the Pauli MASA of an input Lagrangian of $G$ to the diagonal matrices. Then for every affine permutation $\alpha$ of $\F_2^3$, if $\alpha\pi$ and the translations preserve a common complete affine flag, so do $\alpha$, $\pi$ and the translations.

finite_domain: The four gates I, CS_yz, CCZ and CS_yz CCZ; the 135 Lagrangians of V_3; the 21 complete affine flags and the 1,344 affine permutations of F_2^3.

covered_subclaims: The witnesses of each gate (135, 3, 15 and 3, all of the form (L,L)); for each of the 156 input Lagrangians, the flag implication for all 1,344 affine permutations against the 21 flags; the counterexample D of the paper.

remaining_work: No verifier of supplied evidence separate from the recomputation.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
